definitions.accuracy: Out of the games that had a winner, the share where the team the model said was more likely to win actually won. Tied games are left out.
definitions.bet_rule: Bet 1 paper unit on a team when the model gives it at least 4 percentage points more chance to win than the market does (after removing the bookmaker's margin), at that team's listed odds. Otherwise no bet. Ties are refunded.
definitions.brier: Another probability score: the average squared gap between the stated chance and what happened (1 = won, 0 = lost). Lower is better; 0.25 is what a coin flip scores.
definitions.ci95: 95% confidence interval: the range the true value plausibly lies in given how few games there are. Rates use the Wilson interval; averages (log loss, Brier, ROI, CLV) use a t-interval.
definitions.clv: Closing line value: how far the market's probability for the side bet moved between the prediction and the last line saved before kickoff. If the market keeps moving toward your bets, that is the most reliable early sign of a real edge. It is the only evidence the pre-registered 2026 rule accepts.
definitions.home_baseline: The simplest possible strategy: always pick the home team.
definitions.log_loss: A score for how good the win probabilities were, not just the picks. Confident wrong calls are punished hard. Lower is better; 0.693 is what a coin flip scores.
definitions.mcnemar_p: Exact McNemar test comparing two models on the same games, using only the games where exactly one of them was right. p below 0.05 would mean the gap is unlikely to be luck.
definitions.pre_registered: The rules and pass/fail thresholds were written down and frozen before the results existed.
definitions.prediction_committed_at: Author timestamp of the local git commit that added the week's prediction file. Set by the owner's computer; it is not proof of when the commit was pushed to GitHub.
definitions.retroactive: The 2026 betting rule applied after the fact to seasons it was not written for. Descriptive only; it was never a live or pre-registered test.
definitions.roi: Return on investment: units won divided by units staked. Tied games are refunded and left out. +10% means 10 cents profit per dollar bet.
definitions.units: Profit from paper bets of 1 unit each at the real listed odds (bookmaker margin included). +1.00 means one stake's worth of profit. No real money was ever bet.
definitions.vegas_favorite: Always pick the team the betting market favored by the point spread. For 2023-2025 this is one untimestamped line per game (most likely the closing line); for 2026 it is the line saved at the moment the prediction was logged.
definitions.vegas_implied: The betting market's own win probability, read from the moneyline odds with the bookmaker's built-in margin removed so both teams add up to 100%.

held_out_2023_24.label: 2023-24 walk-forward test (held out)
held_out_2023_24.line_timing: untimestamped nflverse line, most likely the closing line
held_out_2023_24.retroactive_bets_note: The 2026 betting rule applied after the fact to the 2023-24 predictions at the historical (most likely closing) moneylines. It was not pre-registered for these seasons and is descriptive only.
held_out_2023_24.selection_note: LR-tuned was named the deployment model AFTER these 2023-24 results were known (Phase 7), on simplicity grounds, not because it scored highest. The four models are statistically tied: no pair differs at p < 0.05 (exact McNemar; LR-tuned vs LR-untuned p = 0.0963, RandomForest p = 0.3240, HGB-tuned p = 0.3222; smallest p over all six pairs = 0.0963). Its 64.3% is the highest of four tied scores (62.9%-64.3%), so treat it as an optimistic pick from that range.
held_out_2023_24.train_rule: Each season predicted by a model trained only on earlier seasons (2002-2022 -> 2023; 2002-2023 -> 2024). Hyperparameters and features were fixed on the 2022 validation season.

governing_amendment.disclosure: Written after the weeks 4-8 log losses were visible. The decision is NO SWAP under either wording: without the amendment the checkpoint never runs and the champion continues by default.
governing_amendment.summary: Week 9 was entirely missed and week 8 partially missed, so 'after week 9 is fully graded' could never happen. Amendment 4 changes only WHEN the checkpoint runs: once every window week is fully graded or is a missed week (no prediction file, every kickoff past). Missed games count as 0 games. The decision rule, margin, test and window (weeks 4-9) are unchanged.

checkpoint.rule: The challenger replaces the champion only if its mean per-game log loss over weeks 4-9 is lower by more than 0.010 AND a one-sided paired t-test gives p < 0.05 (docs/PHASE10_PREREG.md section 5).

week_status.9: missed (no prediction file, every kickoff past)

clv_verdict.clv_window_rule: Amendment 3: CLV is measured only against a snapshot at least 6 hours after the prediction snapshot and before kickoff; otherwise the bet is excluded and counted.
clv_verdict.rule: Evidence of an edge ONLY if the official bets' mean CLV > 0 with a one-sided t-test p < 0.05. ROI never counts as evidence (docs/PHASE10_PREREG.md section 4).
clv_verdict.scorecard_line: **No evidence of an edge** under the rule (as of the games graded so far).
clv_verdict.statement: No evidence of an edge under the rule (as of the games graded so far).

live_2026.label: 2026 live shadow mode (paper trading, no real money)
live_2026.line_timing: line snapshot saved when the prediction was logged (usually Wednesday), not the close
live_2026.provenance_note: prediction_committed_at is the local git author time of the commit that added each week's prediction file. The owner's computer sets it, so it is not proof of push time.

prereg_2025.label: 2025 pre-registered holdout
prereg_2025.line_timing: untimestamped nflverse line, most likely the closing line
prereg_2025.probabilities: raw (uncalibrated); the pre-registered calibration step was not adopted
prereg_2025.retroactive_bets_note: The 2026 betting rule applied after the fact to the 2025 predictions at the historical (most likely closing) moneylines. It was not part of the 2025 pre-registration and is descriptive only.
prereg_2025.selection_note: LR-tuned was already the provisional deployment model, chosen after the 2023-24 results were known. This 2025 test then applied a rule written in advance: another model replaces it only if it is significantly better. None was. HGB-tuned scored higher (177/271 vs 167/271), but McNemar p = 0.0525 missed the 0.05 bar, and its log loss was worse. Of the six pairwise McNemar tests, LR-untuned vs HGB-tuned (p = 0.0072), RandomForest vs HGB-tuned (p = 0.0309) fell below 0.05, and only the first survives a correction for running six tests. Disclosure: the run was executed before the owner's formal approval of the pre-registration (an agent error). The executed protocol was byte-identical by hash to the one under review (docs/PHASE8_RESULTS.md).
prereg_2025.train_rule: All four models trained on 2002-2024 and scored once on 2025 under rules written in advance (docs/PHASE8_PREREG.md).
